text:
You’re looking to consolidate KPI tracking from multiple Excel sheets and sources into one owner-controlled reporting process with clearer graphs and selective sharing, and that’s exactly the kind of reporting cleanup I help with.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’d be glad to help you simplify this setup without losing the flexibility your team needs.

For a similar KPI challenge, I built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. The project replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report built on a star-schema model. That consolidation also reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. The key value was not just cleaner reporting, but a much more reliable structure for bringing multiple inputs into one source of truth.

For your case, I’d focus on creating a single master entry/reporting file or reporting layer that can accept manual inputs from your team, while keeping ownership centralized so you control access and can share only the sections managers need. Since you’re open to Zapier but not committed to auto-filling from source systems, we can evaluate whether Zapier adds value or whether a simpler Google Sheets / Excel / Power BI workflow is the better fit for your current process. My priority would be to reduce the number of pages and sources feeding the report, clarify the graphs, and make the whole setup easier to maintain.

I’m comfortable working through messy spreadsheets, organizing KPI definitions, and turning scattered data into a cleaner reporting structure. If needed, I can also help map the current flow from QuickBooks Online, Field Edge, and the manual entry points so the final solution is practical for your team.

Would you like the final setup to live in Excel, Google Sheets, or a reporting tool like Power BI so you can control permissions and sharing most easily?
